changes: Eight tuned partials ring with the track, shared by one to four voices (VOIC).
TYPE gives every voice a body: PURE, STRNG, TUBE, BAR, PLATE, DRUM or BELL.
CHRD picks the voices' chord; lock it per trig for chord changes, and SCALE keeps it in a key.
COLUN on the setup page makes PTCH a Colundi degree and snaps every voice to a Colundi frequency.
TONE chooses which partials ring; MIX takes the dry out quickly (-26 dB at 100).
